# APT packages required for Xibalba CI builds
# 
# This file defines the eBPF dependencies needed for building.
# Changing this file will invalidate the GitHub Actions cache and
# trigger a fresh package installation.
#
# Pre-installed on ubuntu-latest (don't need to install):
#   - clang
#   - llvm
#   - gcc
#
# Need to install:
libbpf-dev
libelf-dev
linux-headers-generic
